record.paper_title: Current work and open problems in the numerical analysis of Volterra functional equations with vanishing delays
record.original_question: For the multi-delay pantograph-type Volterra functional integral equation u(t) = g(t) + \sum_{j=1}^r b_j(t)u(θ_j(t)) + \sum_{j=1}^r (V_{θ_j}u)(t) on a uniform mesh, where θ_j(t) = q_j t and 0 < q_1 < \cdots < q_r < 1 with r \ge 2, what are the optimal global and local convergence orders of the collocation solution and of the iterated collocation solution?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 2.4 Establish the optimal (global and local) orders of convergence of the collocation and iterated collocation solutions (on uniform meshes) for the multi-delay pantograph-type VFIE u(t) = g(t) +∑r j=1 bj (t)u(θj (t) +∑r j=1 (Vθj u)(t), t \in I

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the multi-delay pantograph-type Volterra functional integral equation
$$u(t)=g(t)+\sum_{j=1}^{r} b_j(t)\,u(\theta_j(t))+\sum_{j=1}^{r}(V_{\theta_j}u)(t),\qquad t\in I=[0,T],$$
where:
- $r\ge 2$ is an integer;
- the proportional (vanishing) delays are $\theta_j(t)=q_j t$ with $0<q_1<q_2<\cdots<q_r<1$;
- $g\in C^m(I)$ and $b_j\in C^m(I)$ are given smooth functions;
- each delay Volterra operator is
$$(V_{\theta_j}u)(t)=\int_{0}^{\theta_j(t)} K_j(t,s)\,u(s)\,ds,$$
with smooth kernels $K_j$.

Fix a uniform mesh $I_N=\{t_n=nh:\ n=0,1,\dots,N,\ h=T/N\}$ and a set of collocation parameters $0\le c_1<c_2<\cdots<c_m\le 1$. Let $S_{m-1}^{(-1)}(I_N)$ denote the space of (possibly discontinuous) piecewise polynomials of degree at most $m-1$ on $I_N$. Let $u_h\in S_{m-1}^{(-1)}(I_N)$ be the collocation solution defined by requiring the equation to hold at the collocation points $t_{n,i}=t_n+c_i h$, and let $u_h^{\mathrm{it}}$ denote the corresponding iterated collocation solution obtained by substituting $u_h$ into the right-hand side.

Determine the optimal global order of convergence
$$\|u-u_h\|_{\infty}=O(h^{p})\quad\text{and}\quad \|u-u_h^{\mathrm{it}}\|_{\infty}=O(h^{p'})$$
and the optimal local (mesh-point) orders
$$\max_{0\le n\le N}|u(t_n)-u_h(t_n)|=O(h^{q}),\qquad \max_{0\le n\le N}|u(t_n)-u_h^{\mathrm{it}}(t_n)|=O(h^{q'})$$
attainable on uniform meshes, in terms of $m$, the collocation parameters $\{c_i\}$, and the delay ratios $\{q_j\}$.
artifact.category_tag: collocation methods for delay Volterra integral equations
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent literature on collocation for pantograph-type Volterra integral equations with multiple proportional delays exists (e.g., works on VIFEMPDs and multistep collocation for vanishing-delay Volterra equations), and superconvergence properties have been studied. However, the search did not produce a definitive resolution of the optimal global and local convergence orders for the multi-delay pantograph VFIE on uniform meshes in the general setting posed, so the status remains unclear.

status_evidence.title: Collocation methods for pantograph-type Volterra functional equations with multiple delays
status_evidence.snippet: Collocation methods applied to Volterra integral functional equations with multiple proportional delays, with convergence and superconvergence analysis.
status_evidence.claim: Related work has addressed collocation convergence for multi-delay pantograph-type Volterra equations, but optimal orders in the precise formulation are not clearly established.

status_evidence.title: Multistep collocation technique for a pantograph-type Volterra integral equation
status_evidence.snippet: High-rate multistep collocation for second-type vanishing delay Volterra integral equations.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to study convergence of collocation for vanishing-delay Volterra equations, indicating ongoing research.
